title: Serve SPA fallback with 200 for routable paths in prod static serving

unresolved.first_comment: Blocking on Windows: path comes from StaticFiles.get_path, normalized with os.path.normpath, so on Windows it arrives as 'articles\7'; the route regexes only understand '/', so every multi-segment routable path keeps its 404 status there. Fix + 2 regression tests ready in 47b9992a on claude/pr-6996-review-97oxj9, not yet cherry-picked into this PR.

notes: Changed since this morning: masenf (MEMBER) posted a thorough production-readiness review at 2026-09-04T18:32Z (self-built a sample app with 10 route shapes, drove reflex run --env prod with curl + headless Chromium across 6 configurations). Found one BLOCKING bug: on Windows, StaticFiles.get_path normalizes with os.path.normpath so multi-segment routable paths (e.g. /articles/7) arrive as 'articles\\7' and never match the route regexes, so the fix has no effect there for anything but single-segment routes. A fix + 2 regression tests are ready to cherry-pick (commit 47b9992a on branch claude/pr-6996-review-97oxj9) but NOT yet applied to this PR's branch (head sha unchanged: 319b3eb).
